comment: Chromium, stainless steel and titanium can be handles and anvils but had no nails, so they could never be a binding. Vanilla leaves them out of metalnailsandstrips and out of the recipe that smiths it; these ops add them to both.

These three are all near-neutral greys, and the sheet texture the item normally uses is noisy enough that its base colour is lost: measured across the sheet art they sit within 16-21 of each other per channel, which reads as one texture on a 32px nails icon. The plate art for the same metals is flatter - chromium spans 174-196 rather than 132-181 - so the colour that distinguishes them survives at icon size, and the pairwise separation rises to 21-23. Only these three are redirected; every other metal keeps the sheet texture, whose extra detail is worth having where the colour already tells them apart.

Reinforcement strength scales with hardness, the same axis Haft's binding stats use. Steel is vanilla's top at 1200 (HB 150); chromium HB 110 lands below it, stainless HB 180 and titanium HB 200 above.
Without this the nails exist as an item but nothing can smith them.
